# Subprobability mass function Caution: This file is experimental. The interface may change in the future. `R.-pmf T` : subprobability mass function for choiceType `T` with values in `R` `isSubPmf` : interface for functions that satisfy the property of subprobability : mass function `\P_[mu] E` : probability of the event `E` w.r.t. the subpmf `mu` `\P_[mu, A] E` : probability of the event `E` conditioned on the event `A` `\E_[mu] f` : expectation of the real-valued function `f` w.r.t. the subpmf `mu` `subpmf_sum` : alternative characterization of subpmf in terms of uniq lists `pmf_esummable mu f` : summability of the function `f` weighted by the subpmf `mu` `pmf_zero` : the zero subpmf `pmf_restr p mu` : restriction of `mu` to the predicate `p`, zero outside of it `pmf_count s` : subpmf on the elements of the sequence `s`, each weighted by its : number of occurrences in `s` `pmf_ret x` : degenerated subpmf `pmf_uniform s` : uniform subpmf on the elements of the sequence `s` `pmf_flip r` : subpmf on booleans, `true` with probability `r` clamped to $[0, 1]$ `\bind_(i <- d) E` : monadic bind for subpmf `pmf_bindr f` : reverse monadic bind `pmf_iter n f` : `n`-fold iteration of `pmf_bindr f` from a degenerated subpmf `\lim_(n) E` : limit for index subpmf `pmf_margin h mu` : image of the subpmf `mu` along the function `h` `pmf_swap mu` : image of a subpmf on pairs under the swapping of the components

by apply: le_lt_trans; [exact: subpmf_sum_le1|rewrite ltey].
Qed.

Lemma pmf_prob_bindSource code ESource code fSource code (muSource code : R.-pmf U) :
  \P_[pmf_bind f mu] E = \E_[mu] (fun xSource code => \P_[f x] E).
Proof.
have fin : esummable [set: U] (fun xSource code => ((\P_[f x] E) * mu x)%:E).
  apply/(le_esummable (g := EFin \o mu)) => [x _|//].
  by rewrite !lee_fin mulr_ge0 ?pmf_prob_ge0//= ler_piMl ?pmf_prob_le1.
apply: EFin_inj; rewrite prE_measure measure_of_pmf_bind.
under eq_integral do rewrite -prE_measure.
rewrite -expectation_def expectation_pmfEFin /pmf_expectation fineK//.
exact: esummable_esum_fin_num.
Qed.

Lemma pmf_prob_marginSource code ESource code fSource code (muSource code : R.-pmf U) :
  \P_[pmf_margin f mu] E = \P_[mu] [pred xSource code | f x \in E].
Proof.
rewrite /pmf_margin pmf_prob_bind pmf_prob_expectation.
by apply/supp_eq_pmf_expectation=> x _; rewrite pmf_prob_ret.
Qed.

Lemma pmf_expectation_leSource code muSource code f1Source code f2Source code :
    pmf_esummable mu f1 -> pmf_esummable mu f2 -> f1 <=1 f2 ->
  \E_[mu] f1 <= \E_[mu] f2.
Proof.
move=> sm1 sm2 le_f; rewrite /pmf_expectation; apply: fine_le.
- exact: (esummable_esum_fin_num sm1).
- exact: (esummable_esum_fin_num sm2).
- by apply: le_esum => x /=; rewrite lee_fin ler_wpM2r ?ge0_mu.
Qed.

Lemma le_mem_pmf_probSource code E1Source code E2Source code muSource code :
    (forall xSource code, x \in supp mu -> x \in E1 -> x \in E2) ->
  \P_[mu] E1 <= \P_[mu] E2.
Proof.
move=> le; rewrite -lee_fin !prE.
apply: le_esum => x _; rewrite lee_fin.
case/boolP: (x \in supp mu) => [xin|/memNsuppP ->]; last by rewrite !mulr0.
have hE : (E1 x)%:R <= (E2 x)%:R :> R.
  rewrite ler_nat; have := le x xin; rewrite -!topredE /=.
  by case: (E1 x) => // ->.
by rewrite ler_wpM2r // ?ge0_mu.
Qed.

Lemma le_pmf_pmf_probSource code ASource code (muSource code nuSource code : R.-pmf T) :
    (forall xSource code, x \in supp nu -> x \in A -> nu x <= mu x) ->
  \P_[nu] A <= \P_[mu] A.
Proof.
move=> h; rewrite -lee_fin !prE.
apply: le_esum => x _; rewrite lee_fin.
case/boolP : (x \in supp nu) => [/h {}h|]; last first.
  by move/memNsuppP => ->; rewrite mulr0 mulr_ge0// ler0n.
by case/boolP: (A x) => [/h|]; rewrite ?(mul0r, mul1r).
Qed.

Lemma pmf_cprob_le1Source code ASource code BSource code muSource code : \P_[mu, B] A <= 1.
Proof.
move: (pmf_prob_ge0 B mu); rewrite /pmf_cprob le_eqVlt.
case/predU1P => [<-|]; first by rewrite invr0 mulr0 ler01.
move/ler_pdivrMr=> ->; rewrite mul1r.
by apply: le_mem_pmf_prob => x _ /andP[].
Qed.

Lemma pmf_cprob_sumSource code ASource code muSource code : 0 < \P_[mu] A ->
  fine (\esum_(xSource code in [set: T]) (\P_[mu, A] (pred1 x))%:E) = 1.
Proof.
move=> gt0.
have a0 i : 0 <= (A i)%:R * mu i by rewrite mulr_ge0// ler0n.
have hpr1 x : \P_[mu] [predI pred1 x & A] = (A x)%:R * mu x.
  rewrite /pmf_prob.
  rewrite (eq_esum _ _ ( fun ySource code => if x == y then ((A y)%:R * mu y)%:E else 0)).
    move=> y _ /=; rewrite !inE [y == x]eq_sym.
    by case: ifP => xy; rewrite ?mul0r.
  by rewrite esum_if_eq_op_set1.
rewrite (eq_esum _ _ (fun xSource code => ((\P_[mu] A)^-1 * ((A x)%:R * mu x))%:E)).
  by move=> x _; rewrite /pmf_cprob hpr1; congr (_ %:E); rewrite mulrC.
rewrite (EFin_esumZ _ _ a0).
  by rewrite invr_ge0// pmf_prob_ge0.
by rewrite -prE -EFinM mulVf// gt_eqF.
Qed.

Lemma eq0_pmf_probSource code muSource code ESource code : \P_[mu] E = 0 -> forall xSource code, x \in E -> mu x = 0.
Proof.
move=> hE x xE.
have hle : \P_[mu] (pred1 x) <= \P_[mu] E.
  by apply: subset_pmf_prob => y; rewrite !inE => /eqP ->.
move: hle; rewrite hE pmf_prob_pred1 => h.
by apply/eqP; rewrite eq_le h /=.
Qed.

Lemma pmf_probIDSource code ASource code BSource code muSource code :
  \P_[mu] A = \P_[mu] [predI A & B] + \P_[mu] [predI A & predC B].
Proof.
have ge0 (PSource code : pred T) iSource code : (0 <= ((P i)%:R * mu i)%:E)%E.
  by rewrite lee_fin mulr_ge0 ?ler0n ?ge0_mu.
apply: EFin_inj; rewrite EFinD !prE.
rewrite -(esumD (fun iSource code _ => ge0 _ i) (fun iSource code _ => ge0 _ i)).
apply: eq_esum => x _; rewrite -EFinD; congr (_ %:E).
rewrite !inE -!topredE /= -mulrDl; congr (_ * _).
rewrite -natrD; congr (_ %:R).
by case: (A x); case: (B x).
Qed.

Lemma pmf_prob_predU_indepSource code (ASource code BSource code : pred T) (muSource code : R.-pmf T) :
    (forall xSource code, x \in A -> x \notin B) ->
  \P_[mu] [predU A & B] = \P_[mu] A + \P_[mu] B.
Proof.
move=> dsj.
have ge0 (PSource code : pred T) iSource code : (0 <= ((P i)%:R * mu i)%:E)%E.
  by rewrite lee_fin mulr_ge0 ?ler0n ?ge0_mu.
apply: EFin_inj; rewrite EFinD !prE.
rewrite -(esumD (fun iSource code _ => ge0 _ i) (fun iSource code _ => ge0 _ i)).
apply: eq_esum => x _; rewrite -EFinD; congr (_ %:E).
rewrite !inE -!topredE /= -mulrDl; congr (_ * _).
rewrite -natrD; congr (_ %:R).
case/boolP: (A x) => Ax; case/boolP: (B x) => Bx //=.
by move/dsj: Ax; rewrite -topredE /= Bx.
Qed.

Lemma pmf_prob_mem_mapSource code fSource code muSource code (rSource code : seq U) : uniq r ->
  \P_[mu] [pred xSource code | f x \in r] =
  \sum_(ySource code <- r) \P_[mu] [pred xSource code | f x == y].
Proof.
elim: r => [_|y r ih]; first by rewrite big_nil pred0_pmf_prob_eq0.
case/andP => yNr /ih {ih}h; rewrite big_cons -h -pmf_prob_predU_indep.
  by move=> x; rewrite !inE => /eqP ->.
exact/eq_pmf_prob.
Qed.

Lemma pmf_prob_memSource code muSource code (rSource code : seq T) : uniq r ->
  \P_[mu] [pred xSource code | x \in r] = \sum_(xSource code <- r) mu x.
Proof.
elim: r => [_|y r ih]; first by rewrite big_nil pred0_pmf_prob_eq0//.
case/andP=> yNr /ih {ih}h; rewrite big_cons /= -pmf_prob_pred1.
by rewrite -h -pmf_prob_predU_indep // => x /eqP ->.
Qed.

Lemma pmf_prob_bigor_indepSource code muSource code (PSource code : I -> pred T) (rSource code : seq I) : uniq r ->
  (forall p1Source code p2Source code xSource code,
    p1 != p2 -> p1 \in r -> p2 \in r -> x \in P p1 -> x \notin P p2) ->
  \P_[mu] [pred xSource code | has [pred pSource code | x \in P p] r] =
  \sum_(pSource code <- r) \P_[mu] (P p).
Proof.
move=> uq_r dj; pose S xSource code := \big[orb/false]_(pSource code <- r) (x \in P p).
rewrite (@eq_pmf_prob _ _ _ S) => [x|]; first by rewrite !inE -big_has.
rewrite {}/S; elim: r uq_r dj => [_|p r ih /andP[pNr /ih {ih}h]] dj.
 by rewrite big_nil pred0_pmf_prob_eq0 // => x; rewrite big_nil.
rewrite big_cons -h => [p1 p2 x ne_p p1r p2r|].
  by apply/dj=> //; rewrite in_cons (p1r, p2r) orbT.
rewrite -pmf_prob_predU_indep => [x xNPp|].
  rewrite -topredE /= big_has; apply/hasPn => y y_in_r.
  apply/(dj p); rewrite ?in_cons ?(eqxx, y_in_r, orbT) //.
  by apply: contra pNr => /eqP ->.
by apply/eq_pmf_prob => x; rewrite -!topredE /= big_cons.
Qed.

Lemma pmf_prob_predUSource code ASource code BSource code muSource code : \P_[mu] [predU A & B] =
  \P_[mu] A + \P_[mu] B - \P_[mu] [predI A & B].
Proof.
apply/eqP; rewrite eq_sym subr_eq [in X in _==X]addrC; apply/eqP.
rewrite (pmf_probID _ B) -addrA -pmf_prob_predU_indep => [x|].
  by rewrite !inE => /andP[].
congr (_ + _); apply/eq_pmf_prob => x; rewrite !inE -!topredE /=.
by apply/orb_id2r => /negbTE ->; rewrite andbT.
Qed.

Lemma pmf_prob_predISource code ASource code BSource code muSource code : \P_[mu] [predI A & B] =
  \P_[mu] A + \P_[mu] B - \P_[mu] [predU A & B].
Proof.
by rewrite pmf_prob_predU subKr. Qed.

Lemma le_pmf_prob_predUSource code ASource code BSource code muSource code : \P_[mu] [predU A & B] <= \P_[mu] A + \P_[mu] B.
Proof.
by rewrite pmf_prob_predU lerBlDr lerDl pmf_prob_ge0. Qed.

Lemma le_pmf_prob_predISource code ASource code BSource code muSource code : \P_[mu] [predI A & B] <= \P_[mu] A + \P_[mu] B.
Proof.
by rewrite pmf_prob_predI lerBlDr lerDl pmf_prob_ge0. Qed.

Lemma pmf_prob_predCSource code ESource code muSource code: \P_[mu](predC E) = \P_[mu] predT - \P_[mu] E.
Proof.
apply/esym/eqP; rewrite subr_eq -pmf_prob_predU_indep//.
by apply/eqP/eq_pmf_prob => x; rewrite !inE orNb.
Qed.

Lemma pmf_prob_splitSource code BSource code ASource code muSource code : \P_[mu] A =
    \P_[mu]        B  * \P_[mu,       B] A
  + \P_[mu] (predC B) * \P_[mu, predC B] A.
Proof.
suff h A' B': \P_[mu] [predI A' & B'] = \P_[mu] B' * \P_[mu, B'] A'.
  by rewrite (pmf_probID _ B); congr (_ + _); exact/h.
rewrite /pmf_cprob mulrCA; have [] := eqVneq (\P_[mu] B') 0; last first.
  by move=> nzPB'; rewrite divff // mulr1.
move=> zPB'; rewrite zPB' invr0 !mulr0; apply/pmf_prob_eq0.
move=> x mux; move/eq0_pmf_prob: zPB' => /(_ x) h; rewrite !inE.
by apply/negP=> /andP[_ /h] /mem_suppP.
Qed.

Lemma pmf_cprob_pred1Source code (muSource code : R.-pmf T) xSource code ASource code :
  \P_[mu, A] (pred1 x) = (A x)%:R * mu x / \P_[mu] A.
Proof.
rewrite /pmf_cprob; congr (_ / _); rewrite /pmf_prob.
rewrite (eq_esum _ _ (fun ySource code => if x == y then ((A y)%:R * mu y)%:E else 0)).
  move=> y _ /=; rewrite !inE [y == x]eq_sym.
  by case: ifP => xy; rewrite ?xy /= ?mul1r ?mul0r.
by rewrite esum_if_eq_op_set1.
Qed.

Lemma esummable_pmf_prob_fSource code fSource code muSource code (PSource code : pred T):
  pmf_esummable mu f ->
  esummable [set: T] (EFin \o (fun xSource code => (P x)%:R * (f x * mu x))).
Proof.
move=> sm; rewrite /esummable //= .
rewrite (eq_esum _ _ (fun xSource code => `|((P x)%:R)%:E * (f x * mu x)%:E|)%E).
  by move => i _ //; rewrite -abseM.
apply: esummableMl; last exact: sm.
exists 1%:E => [x|//].
by rewrite gee0_abs ?lee_fin ?ler0n// lern1 leq_b1.
Qed.

Lemma esum_is_fin_num_mu_fSource code fSource code muSource code (PSource code : pred T):
  pmf_esummable mu f ->
  \esum_(xSource code in [set: T]) ((P x)%:R * (f x * mu x))%:E \is a fin_num.
Proof.
by move=> ?; apply: esummable_esum_fin_num; exact: esummable_pmf_prob_f.
Qed.

Lemma pmf_prob_cexpectation_esumSource code muSource code fSource code (PSource code : pred T):
    pmf_esummable mu f ->
  \P_[mu] P * \E_[mu, P] f =
  fine (\esum_(xSource code in [set: T]) ((P x)%:R * (f x * mu x))%:E).
Proof.
move=> sm.
have [c0|cn0] := eqVneq (\P_[mu] P) 0.
  rewrite c0 mul0r [X in fine X](_ : _ = 0) ?fine0//.
  rewrite esum1// => x _.
  apply/eqP; rewrite eqe mulrCA mulf_eq0; apply/orP; right.
  have [Px|]/= := boolP (P x); last by rewrite mul0r.
  by rewrite mul1r (eq0_pmf_prob _ Px).
rewrite /pmf_cexpectation.
rewrite (eq_esum _ _ (fun xSource code => (\P_[mu] P)^-1 %:E * ((P x)%:R * (f x * mu x))%:E)%E).
  move=> x ?.
  rewrite /= pmf_cprob_pred1 -EFinM; congr (_ %:E).
  by rewrite mulrA mulrC; congr (_ * _); exact: mulrCA.
rewrite (esummable_esumZ _ (esummable_pmf_prob_f P sm)).
  by rewrite abse_fin_num.
by rewrite fineM ?abse_fin_num ?sum_fin_num_mu_f// mulVKf.
Qed.

Lemma pmf_expectation_splitSource code ASource code fSource code muSource code : pmf_esummable mu f ->
  \E_[mu] f = \P_[mu]        A  * \E_[mu,       A] f
            + \P_[mu] (predC A) * \E_[mu, predC A] f.
Proof.
move=> sm.
rewrite [in RHS](pmf_prob_cexpectation_esum A)//.
rewrite [in RHS](pmf_prob_cexpectation_esum (predC A))//.
rewrite [in LHS]/pmf_expectation -fineD ?esum_is_fin_num_mu_f//.
congr fine.
rewrite -esummable_esumD//; [exact: esummable_pmf_prob_f..|].
apply: eq_esum => x ? /=; rewrite -EFinD; congr EFin.
by rewrite -mulrDl -natrD addnC addn_negb mul1r.
Qed.

Lemma bounded_pmf_expectation_leSource code muSource code FSource code (MSource code : R) :
  0 <= M -> (forall xSource code, `|F x| <= M) -> \E_[mu] F <= M.
Proof.
move=> ge0M bd; apply/(@le_trans _ _ (\E_[mu] (fun _ => M))).
  apply/pmf_expectation_le.
  - by apply/bounded_pmf_esummable; exists M.
  - exact/pmf_esummable_cst.
  - by move=> x; apply/(le_trans _ (bd x))/ler_norm.
by rewrite pmf_expectation_cst ler_piMl // pmf_prob_le1.
Qed.

Lemma ge0_pmf_expectation_bindSource code (muSource code : R.-pmf T) (nuSource code : T -> R.-pmf U) (gSource code : U -> R) :
    (forall ySource code, 0 <= g y) -> (forall etaSource code, pmf_esummable eta g) ->
  \E_[pmf_bind nu mu] g = \E_[mu] (fun xSource code => \E_[nu x] g).
Proof.
move=> g0 sg; rewrite [LHS]pmf_expectationE expectation_pmf_bind_EFin//.
by rewrite -pmf_expectationE.
Qed.

Lemma le_pmf_esummableSource code {VSource code : choiceType} (muSource code : R.-pmf V) (kSource code hSource code : V -> R) :
  (forall xSource code, `|k x| <= `|h x|) -> pmf_esummable mu h -> pmf_esummable mu k.
Proof.
move=> kh; rewrite /pmf_esummable => fh.
rewrite esummableE ge0_fin_numE.
  by apply: esum_ge0 => i _; exact: abse_ge0.
apply: (le_lt_trans _ fh); apply: le_esum.
by move => ? ?; rewrite lee_fin !normrM ler_wpM2r.
Qed.

Lemma pmf_esummable_expectationSource code (muSource code : R.-pmf T) (nuSource code : T -> R.-pmf U) (gSource code : U -> R) :
    (forall ySource code, 0 <= g y) -> (forall etaSource code, pmf_esummable eta g) ->
  pmf_esummable mu (fun xSource code => \E_[nu x] g).
Proof.
move=> g0 sg.
have hge0 x : 0 <= \E_[nu x] g * mu x by rewrite mulr_ge0// pmf_expectation_ge0.
rewrite /pmf_esummable esummableE.
rewrite (eq_esum _ _ (EFin \o (fun xSource code => \E_[nu x] g * mu x))).
  by move=> x _ /=; rewrite ger0_norm.
rewrite -expectation_pmfEFin -(expectation_pmf_bind_EFin mu nu g0 sg).
rewrite expectation_pmfEFin.
exact: (esummable_esum_fin_num (sg (pmf_bind nu mu))).
Qed.

Lemma pmf_expectation_bindSource code muSource code (nuSource code : T -> R.-pmf U ) FSource code :
    (forall etaSource code, pmf_esummable eta F) ->
  \E_[pmf_bind nu mu] F = \E_[mu] (fun xSource code => \E_[nu x] F).
Proof.
move=> sF.
have spF eta : pmf_esummable eta F^\+.
  exact: (le_pmf_esummable (le_funrpos F) (sF eta)).
have snF eta : pmf_esummable eta F^\-.
  exact: (le_pmf_esummable (le_funrneg F) (sF eta)).
transitivity (\E_[mu] (fun xSource code => \E_[nu x] F^\+)
            - \E_[mu] (fun xSource code => \E_[nu x] F^\-)).
  rewrite -(ge0_pmf_expectation_bind mu nu _ spF)//.
  rewrite -(ge0_pmf_expectation_bind mu nu _ snF) //.
  rewrite -(pmf_expectationB (spF _) (snF _)); congr (\E_[pmf_bind nu mu] _).
  exact/esym/funrposBneg.
rewrite -(pmf_expectationB (pmf_esummable_expectation mu nu _ spF)
  (pmf_esummable_expectation mu nu _ snF))//.
apply: supp_eq_pmf_expectation => x _ /=.
rewrite -(pmf_expectationB (spF _) (snF _)).
by congr (\E_[nu x] _); exact: funrposBneg.
Qed.

End PrTheory.

Section mono_esum.
Context {RSource code : realType} {TSource code : choiceType} {fSource code : (R.-pmf T)^nat}.
Hypothesis ndfSource code : nondecreasing_fun (f : _ -> _ -> _).

Lemma nondecreasing_esum_EfnSource code (ESource code : T -> \bar R):
  (forall mSource code, 0 <= E m)%E ->
  forall mSource code nSource code, (m <= n)%N ->
  (\esum_(xSource code in [set:T]) (E x * (f m x)%:E) <=
   \esum_(xSource code in [set:T]) (E x * (f n x)%:E))%E.
Proof.
move=> hE m n le_mn.
by apply/le_esum => x _; rewrite lee_pmul ?lee_fin//=; exact/lefP/ndf.
Qed.

Lemma esum_pmf_lim_rSource code [ESource code : T -> \bar R] [rSource code : \bar R]:
  (forall mSource code, 0 <= E m)%E ->
  (forall nSource code, \esum_(xSource code in [set: T]) (E x * (f n x)%:E) <= r)%E ->
  (\esum_(xSource code in [set: T]) (E x * ((pmf_lim f) x)%:E) <= r)%E.
Proof.
move => hE h.
rewrite (@eq_esum _ _ _ _ (fun xSource code => ereal_sup (range (fun nSource code =>  E x * (f n x)%:E)%E))).
   move => ? ?; rewrite EFin_pmf_lim_sup//.
  rewrite (@ge0_ereal_supZl_range R T (fun aSource code bSource code => (f b a)%:E)) //.
  by move => ? ?; rewrite lee_fin.
rewrite exchange_esum_ereal_sup//.
- by move => ? ?; rewrite mule_ge0 ?lee_fin.
- by move => ? ? ? ?; rewrite lee_pmul ?lee_fin //; exact/lefP/ndf.
by rewrite ge_ereal_sup//= => x [n s] <-; exact: h.
Qed.

Lemma esum_pmf_lim_r_rSource code [ESource code : T -> R] [rSource code : \bar R]:
  (forall mSource code, 0 <= E m) ->
  (forall nSource code, \esum_(xSource code in [set: T]) ((E x * f n x)%:E) <= r)%E ->
  (\esum_(xSource code in [set: T]) (E x * (pmf_lim f) x)%:E <= r)%E.
Proof.
move=> hE h.
rewrite (eq_esum _ _ (fun xSource code : T => ((E x)%:E * ((pmf_lim f) x)%:E)%E)).
  by move => ? _; rewrite EFinM.
apply: (esum_pmf_lim_r (E := fun xSource code => (E x)%:E)).
  by move=> m; rewrite lee_fin.
move=> n; under eq_esum => x _ do rewrite -EFinM.
exact: h n.
Qed.

Lemma esum_pmf_limSource code (ESource code : pred T) :
  \esum_(xSource code in [set: T]) ((E x)%:R * (pmf_lim f) x)%:E =
  limn (fun nSource code => \esum_(xSource code in [set: T]) ((E x)%:R * f n x)%:E).
Proof.
have hmono n m : (n <= m)%N -> forall xSource code,
    (((E x)%:R * f n x)%:E <= ((E x)%:R * f m x)%:E)%E.
  move=> nm x; rewrite lee_fin ler_wpM2l ?ler0n//.
  exact/lefP/ndf.
transitivity (ereal_sup (range
    (fun nSource code => \esum_(xSource code in [set: T]) ((E x)%:R * f n x)%:E))); last first.
  apply: sup_range_lim => n m nm; apply: le_esum => x _.
  exact: (hmono n m nm x).
rewrite -(@exchange_esum_ereal_sup _ _ (fun xSource code nSource code => ((E x)%:R * f n x)%:E))//.
- by move=> x n; rewrite lee_fin mulr_ge0// ler0n.
- by move => x n m nm; exact: hmono.
apply: eq_esum => x _.
rewrite EFinM EFin_pmf_lim_sup//.
rewrite (@ge0_ereal_supZl_range R T (fun aSource code bSource code => (f b a)%:E)) //.
  by move=> t n; rewrite lee_fin.
